name: PostSteward
positioning: Keep building. Let your agent keep building the market.
problem: Builders should not have to choose between staying in development flow and building market history before launch.
outcome: Keep the product story, engagement and pipeline moving while development continues.
contextModel: Bring the project and GTM context your agent already has. PostSteward is the publishing execution lane, not the system that must own your strategy data.
workflow: agent reads project and GTM context
provider outcome becomes an inspectable receipt

plans.free: Agent publishing, schedules, controlled routing and receipts
plans.advanced: USD 5 per workspace per month for continuing source monitoring, campaign inventory, spacing and scheduled metrics
plans.advancedAvailability: Public billing opens after launch acceptance

sourceDisclosure: This public repository hosts the launch experience only. Product implementation source is not published here.
